1.0.0: Initial release. Records: Find Records, Search Records (full-text), Get Record, Create Record, Create or Update Record, Update Record, Delete Record, plus Create Person, Update Person, Create or Update Person, Find People, Create Company, Update Company, Create or Update Company and Find Companies. Files: Upload File. Lists: List Lists, Find List Entries, Add Record To List, Update List Entry, Remove Record From List. Notes: Create Note, Find Notes, Delete Note. Tasks: Create Task, Get Task, Update Task, Find Tasks, Delete Task. Comments: Create Comment, Delete Comment. Schema: List Objects, List Attributes, List Workspace Members, Get Workspace. Make API Call. Webhook triggers: New Record, Updated Record, Deleted Record, New List Entry, Updated List Entry, New Note, New Task. Authentication with an Attio workspace access token.
1.0.1: Security: upgraded form-data to 4.0.6 (predictable multipart boundary, CRLF injection in field names and filenames).
